competitorName.title: Competitor Name
competitorName.description: The brand you want to spy on (e.g. 'Zomato', 'Jira', 'Notion').

maxPosts.title: Sample Size
maxPosts.description: How many posts to analyze. Higher = Slower but more accurate.

sources.title: Data Sources
sources.description: Select public sources to extract customer signals from.

minSentiment.title: Max Sentiment Score (Filter)
minSentiment.description: Only include signals below this sentiment threshold. 0.0 includes all neutral/negative, -0.2 targets high frustration.

customKeywords.title: Custom Search Keywords
customKeywords.description: Optional: Comma-separated extra terms to search alongside the competitor name.

apiKey.title: Your API Key (Gemini/OpenAI/OpenRouter)
apiKey.description: Optional: Enter your API key for AI-enhanced insights. Leave empty for ML-only analysis. Supports: Gemini, OpenAI GPT, or OpenRouter keys.
